pages.title: Spawn Types
pages.text: Wild Modern Chickens appear alongside vanilla chickens, split into four groups:$(br)$(li)$(l)Normal$() temperate biomes$(li)$(l)Snow$() snowy biomes$(li)$(l)Hell$() the Nether$(li)$(l)End$() the End$(br2)Only low tier breeds spawn naturally. Everything above that must be bred.

pages.title: Spawn Eggs
pages.text: Modern Chickens ships its own spawn eggs for chickens, roosters, Mega Chickens and robot variants. They are the fastest way to test a setup in creative, and several are produced legitimately by the $(l)Avian Dousing Machine$().
